title: Civic Resilience Exercise-to-Improvement Loop
purpose: Demonstrate how a learning objective, exercise observation, evidence record, corrective action and independent retest can be connected without collapsing the result into one score.
scope_limits: Every observation and numeric value in this fixture is synthetic and illustrative.
This is a tabletop exercise record, not an operational response plan or an estimate for a real municipality.
An authority-evidence completeness check is not a legal determination.
A service-floor pass in a synthetic exercise is not evidence of real-world readiness.
This public fixture is for schema development and formative practice, not confirmatory generalization testing.

framework_crosswalk.framework: FEMA Homeland Security Exercise and Evaluation Program (HSEEP)
framework_crosswalk.composition: Exercise objectives, observation, evaluation, after-action findings and corrective-action follow-up.
framework_crosswalk.boundary: This fixture is not an HSEEP-compliant exercise package, FEMA evaluation guide or official after-action report.

framework_crosswalk.framework: IFRC National Society Preparedness Framework and Preparedness for Effective Response
framework_crosswalk.composition: Assessment, prioritisation, work planning, action and accountability, adapted as a learning loop.
framework_crosswalk.boundary: Praxis does not replace IFRC processes, local humanitarian coordination or National Society authority.

framework_crosswalk.composition: A management-system perspective on documented continuity, monitoring, review and continual improvement.
framework_crosswalk.boundary: No ISO conformity assessment or certification is implied.

framework_crosswalk.composition: Risk knowledge, locally led disaster risk reduction, financing and recovery readiness.
framework_crosswalk.boundary: Alignment is a design crosswalk, not UNDRR endorsement or measured impact.

framework_crosswalk.composition: Describe, appraise, redesign and evaluate assessment practice rather than treating assessment as a terminal grade.
framework_crosswalk.boundary: The framework is adapted conceptually; this prototype is not UNESCO-validated.

objectives.capability: Maintain the fictional minimum public-information service floor.
Maintain minimum water-service continuity within the scenario constraints.
Maintain minimum health-logistics continuity and document unresolved dependencies.

measure_catalog.name: Objective evidence coverage
measure_catalog.numerator: Number of scheduled objectives with at least one evaluator-accepted observation and evidence reference.
measure_catalog.guardrail: A written claim without a traceable evidence reference does not count as an observed result.

measure_catalog.name: Service-floor attainment by service
measure_catalog.numerator: For each service, the observed synthetic service-level percentage.
measure_catalog.denominator: The fixture-defined minimum service-floor percentage for that service.
measure_catalog.formula: pass when observed_percent >= required_floor_percent; all-critical-floors-pass is the conjunction across services
measure_catalog.guardrail: Never average service floors into a compensating score. One critical floor failure remains visible even if every other service passes.

measure_catalog.name: Resource feasibility
measure_catalog.numerator: Committed fictional budget points and responder-hours.
measure_catalog.denominator: Available fictional budget points and responder-hours.
measure_catalog.formula: committed / available for each resource pool
measure_catalog.guardrail: Each pool must be checked independently; a budget surplus cannot compensate for exceeding responder-hours.

measure_catalog.name: Authority-evidence completeness
measure_catalog.numerator: Sampled decisions with a named accountable role, cited authority basis and review path recorded.
measure_catalog.guardrail: Measures documentation completeness only. It does not determine whether an action is legally authorized; qualified review remains necessary.

measure_catalog.name: Accessibility-check coverage
measure_catalog.numerator: Scenario-defined accessibility requirements tested and recorded.
measure_catalog.guardrail: Do not infer disability, health status or other sensitive traits about participants. Test the service design, not a person's identity.

measure_catalog.name: Corrective-action verification rate
measure_catalog.numerator: Due corrective actions closed with completion evidence, independent verification and a successful retest.
measure_catalog.denominator: Corrective actions due for review in the cycle.
measure_catalog.formula: independently verified and successfully retested actions / actions due for review
measure_catalog.guardrail: A self-reported 'closed' status without evidence and retest is not verified closure.

measure_catalog.name: Retested failure recurrence
measure_catalog.numerator: Previously failed capability conditions that fail again in the retest.
measure_catalog.denominator: Previously failed capability conditions actually retested.
measure_catalog.formula: repeated failures / previously failed conditions retested
measure_catalog.guardrail: Do not count untested conditions as passed. Report the denominator and missing retests.

measure_catalog.name: Learner transfer and retention
measure_catalog.numerator: Learner performance on delayed and novel assessment tasks, scored against the frozen rubric.
measure_catalog.denominator: Scheduled learner assessments, with missingness disposition.
measure_catalog.formula: Report immediate, 30-day, 90-day and held-out transfer outcomes separately.
measure_catalog.guardrail: Do not merge learner scores with municipal exercise outcomes or infer political beliefs, enlistment interest or personal suitability.

measure_catalog.name: Cost per verified capability improvement
measure_catalog.numerator: Fully loaded programme, exercise, facilitation, access and follow-up costs.
measure_catalog.denominator: Number of independently verified capability improvements sustained at retest.
measure_catalog.guardrail: Define the cost boundary and currency before comparison. Do not report this metric when the denominator is zero; report the numerator and zero verified improvements.

corrective_actions.finding: Public-information continuity fell below its synthetic minimum floor in CYCLE-01.
corrective_actions.root_cause_hypothesis: The exercise team had not tested an accessible fallback publishing process during loss of central coordination.

corrective_actions.finding: Welfare-check coordination fell below its synthetic minimum floor in CYCLE-01.
corrective_actions.root_cause_hypothesis: The exercise team had not documented a privacy-respecting role handoff and reconciliation step.

corrective_actions.finding: Health-logistics continuity remained below its synthetic minimum floor after retest.
corrective_actions.root_cause_hypothesis: A critical dependency and its fallback evidence remain unresolved in the exercise record.

interpretation_guardrails: Do not calculate a single overall resilience score from these dimensions.
Report each essential-service floor separately; a failed critical floor is not compensated by another service's excess.
A corrective action is not verified closed without completion evidence, independent verification and a successful retest.
Unresolved actions remain open and visible; missing evidence is not a pass.
Learning outcomes, exercise outcomes and institution-level capability improvement are separate measurement layers.
A synthetic improvement between two exercise cycles is not a causal estimate and cannot establish real-world readiness.
